text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tokyo Daishoten. Hoping to 
share in the lucky color from her debut 
day, the Trainer heads in wearing an 
orange jacket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey believed she could prove the 
power of feng shui if she became strong 
enough to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with 
her rivals. But that alone wasn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only by surpassing two champions and 
claiming the pinnacle can the power of 
Feng Shui truly be proven— Copano Rickey 
ran, aiming to become the king.
